questions.question: How is God described at the start of Psalm 46?
options: Our rock and redeemer, the lifter of our heads
Our shepherd and our guide, leading us beside still waters
Our portion and reward, the joy of our salvation
Our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble
questions.answer: Our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble

questions.question: What famous command does God give in this psalm?
options: Wait for the LORD and take courage
Trust in the LORD and do good
Be still, and know that I am God
Delight yourself in the LORD always
questions.answer: Be still, and know that I am God

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Be still, and know that I am _____.
There is a river whose streams make glad the city of _____.
